mainEntity.name: What should I bring or wear to a SHRED class?

acceptedAnswer.text: For SHRED classes, you should wear comfortable athletic clothing that allows for a full range of motion. Athletic shoes with good support are essential for the various movements involved. It's also recommended to bring a water bottle to stay hydrated throughout the class. A towel might be useful as these are high-intensity workouts. Personal gear like lifting gloves is optional but not required.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wear comfortable athletic clothing and supportive shoes, and bring a water bottle for SHRED classes.
